metadata.title: Bitcoin and XRP Prices Fall as Cryptos Slide<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Bitcoin Holds Below $60,000 as Cryptos Slide
The price of Bitcoin and other cryptos were edging down Monday as stock futures were rising after the U.S. and Iran said they would stop fighting following tit-for-tat strikes over the weekend.
